{{Quote|Welcome to my parlor...|The Spiderclan stalker|<ref name="Stalker" />}}
An [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' was a member of the [[Spiderclan/Legends|Spiderclan]], one of the clans on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] that made up the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]],<ref name="Stalker" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Date">The ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge|Nightsister's Revengs]]'' expansion set takes place within the timeframe of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', which is set during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref> She had [[Color/Legends|dark]] skin with white [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]], black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black hair. She wore brown [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and wielded two [[Sword/Legends|swords]].<ref name="Stalker" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Spiderclan stalker was pictured on the card "Spiderclan Stalker" from the ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge|Nightsister's Revenge]]'' expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''. The set was released on [[December 15]], [[2009]].<ref name="Stalker" /> The Spiderclan Stalker was drawn by [[Ben Wootten]].<ref name="BW Deviant">{{DeviantArt|username=benwootten|url=benwootten/art/Spiderclan-Stalker-151918882|name=[[Ben Wootten]]|text=Spiderclan Stalker|quote=Huge thanks, but I can't take any credit for her design, she from a SW game, I just intepretated her for the card art.}}</ref>
